h1: Custom Taper Candles for Branded Events
metaDescription: Order custom taper candles for weddings, galas, and events. Bulk pricing available. Perfect for branded centerpieces.
introHtml: Custom taper candles add a touch of elegance to formal events like weddings, galas, and corporate dinners. Unlike standard pillar or votive candles, tapers create vertical height on tables, making them ideal for centerpieces and candelabras. Personalize them with your logo or event monogram using silk-screen printing or foil stamping. Choose from classic ivory, white, or bold colors to match your theme. Perfect for creating a refined ambiance that guests will remember.
heroAltText: Custom taper candles with logo imprint in elegant holder for corporate event centerpiece
